title: A fair share of the light
hook: The Works can power every district, but its dials were copied from a smaller machine. Nessa needs a team who can preserve proportions when the scale changes.

sources.title: Nessa’s maintenance handbook
sources.excerpt: For a ratio 1:2, count three shares, divide the total by three to find one share, then scale each part. One quarter is 25%, two quarters are 50%, and three quarters are 75%. Equivalent fractions and percentages describe the same proportion of a whole.

aftermath.gardens: The first current reaches the community gardens. New green shoots appear around Tidewheel Mill. Nessa stays to teach the gardeners how to maintain their share.
aftermath.homes: Warm lanterns return to the mill cottages. Families leave lamps in their windows, and Nessa begins a rota so everyone can help maintain the Works.
